questions.question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. R has exam on Wednesday. Exactly three people have exam between R and Q. P has exam immediately after S, and V has exam immediately before S. Only three people have exam between T and S. Who has exam on Tuesday?

In a certain code language,‘A + B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’,‘A ¥ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’, ‘A x B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’ and ‘A % B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.Which of the following means that G is the brother's wife of S?
options: G + O x A ¥ L % S
G x O + A % L ¥ S
G ¥ O x A % L + S
G + O % A ¥ L x S
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (G + O % A ¥ L x S) है।

questions.question: Rohan starts from Point I and walks south for 32 m. He takes a left turn, walks for 45 m and then takes a right turn, walks for 18 m, and stops at Point K. Reshma starts to walk from Point P, which is 30 m to the west of Point K. She walks 25 m towards the south, then takes a right turn and walks for 15 m, and stops at Point O. What is the shortest distance between Point I and Point O? (All turns are 90-degree turns only.)

Each of C, D, E, F, G, H and X has exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. G has exam on Thursday and F has exam on Saturday. C has exam immediately before H. E has exam on one of the days after X. D has exam immediately after H.How many people have exam between E and D?

Eight people, I, J, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting around a square table, facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centres of the sides. G is sitting second to the right of I. I is not sitting at any of the corners. Only three people are sitting between G and J when counted from the left of G. H is not sitting at any of the corners. E is an immediate neighbour of neither I nor J. Only three people are sitting between E and D. F is not an immediate neighbour of G. How many people are sitting between C and E when counted from the right of C?
